#### Feasibility of Intervention Measure (FIM)

[Measure Link](https://dissemination-implementation.org/assessment-instrument/acceptability-of-intervention-measure-aim)

CFA was assessed for each individual scale in study 2 of scale development, with lowest factor loading item dropped to trim the scale (to present 4 item scales). Cronbach's alpha for trimmed scales: acceptability = .85, appropriateness = .91, and feasibility = .89. \[Note: item wordings are very similar, so expected high alpha\].

Overall scale was fitted for a CFA, and a 3-factor model emerged as best fit compared with 1 and 2 factor models (acceptable fit, CFI = .96, RMSEA = .08, BIC = 8499.4). Several factors *are* highly correlated, with acceptabilty and appropriateness at .77 and appropriateness and feasibility at .

Study 3 reveals acceptable test-retest reliability: acceptability = .83, appropriateness = .87, and feasibility = .88. Median time between responses was 7 weeks.

##### Full Scale Items

AIM

* (INTERVENTION) meets my approval
* (INTERVENTION) is appealing to me.
* I like (INTERVENTION).
* I welcome (INTERVENTION).

IAM 

* (INTERVENTION) seems fitting. 
* (INTERVENTION) seems suitable. 
* (INTERVENTION) seems applicable. 
* (INTERVENTION) seems like a good match.

* (INTERVENTION) seems possible. 
* (INTERVENTION) seems doable.
* (INTERVENTION) seems easy to use.

#### Credibility/Expectancy Questionnaire

2-factor model emerged from factor analysis - focused on the factor that I'm interested in pulling items out here. 
3 items, loading range from .71 (How succesffully do you think this treatment will be in reducing your symptoms) to .88 (How confident would you be in recommending this treatment to a friend). .84 for the other item (how logical does the therapy offered to you seem). Factor was labelled credibility. Cronbach's alpha = .81 (total scale = .84). Acceptable test-retest: credibility r(67) = .75, p < .001, but was assessed only 1 week apart. 

##### Credibility Scale Items

* How logical does the therapy offered to you seem
* How successfully do you think this treatment will be in reducing your symptoms
* How confident would you be in recommending this treatment to a friend

## Other Assessments

#### General Artificial Intelligence Attitude (GAIA-15)

[Measure Link](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2451958826001703?via%3Dihub#tbl3)

Moderate positive correlation with general AI use and specific AI use. Moderate marginal reliability, and unidimensional structure supported.

* I am impressed by what AI can do. 
* I am interested in using AI in my daily life. 
* AI is exciting.
